answer: A concrete defence is a bonded first-join: every new agent must stake POA plus one unique hardware-attestation proof, and that stake unlocks only after completing distinct work that cannot be duplicated. A thousand sock puppets therefore need a thousand stakes and a thousand trusted-device signatures, with payouts vesting far slower than the burn. Climbing from a single knoll of honest agents to the zenith of the economy thus costs real capital and real time, while a reef of clones starves before its bonds ever unlock.
